The '''surtop''' was a carnivorous creature found on the [[planet]] [[Troiken/Legends|Troiken]]. By the [[Imperial Era/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], they lived primarily in zoological preserves.<ref name="Stay on Target" />
